note: The worked example. Exercises every construct in the format: folders, a network with nodes/arcs/chains/points/areas, a top-level route, a track, a waypoint, an area, an application key, and data records on eight different hosts. Its `positions` list is the corpus's ONLY defence against a lon/lat transposition outside a waypoint: one position of every kind the format carries — node, network arc pip, inline chain endpoint, in-network point, in-network area vertex, top-level area vertex, route arc pip, track pip and waypoint. accept/lonlat-transposition.vnx holds a waypoint only, so a reader that swapped the two channels everywhere EXCEPT on waypoints would pass every other case in the corpus. Do not narrow this list.
